title: This Dem Uses Fox as a Platform for Hate
author: Justin Baragona
content:
Good evening, and welcome to this week's **' Ragebait.'**

**Justin Baragona** here, bringing you the latest media dispatches from the
right-wing industrial outrage complex and Bari World. In tonight's edition, we
look at why a former spokesman for Jill Biden is publicly endorsing a Trump-
backed Republican for Senate, and why it may not be all that surprising. Also,
if you thought Fox was bad with the anti-Muslim hate, you ain't seen nothing
yet, while it looks like Bari Weiss's right-wing blog is doing the bidding of
one of its investors.

# **Why Is This Ex-Biden Spox Choosing Mike Rogers Over Abdul El-Sayed?**

Images._

Days after [declaring his
support](https://x.com/MichaelLaRosaDC/status/2086184178035347712) for
Michigan's Trump-endorsed GOP Senate candidate **Mike Rogers** , claiming he
couldn't defend **Abdul El-Sayed 's**
["cowardly"](https://www.foxnews.com/politics/biden-world-veteran-issues-
stark-warning-abdul-el-sayed-crosses-party-lines) stance on 9/11, **Michael
LaRosa** , a one-time press secretary for former First Lady **Jill Biden** ,
doubled down during an appearance on MAGA sycophant **Laura Ingraham 's** Fox
show.

And he made sure to add a dash of Islamophobia too.

Pointing out that he'd already signed a petition calling for New York Mayor
**Zohran Mamdani** to be banned from the 9/11 commemoration next month, LaRosa
demanded that El-Sayed fly to the Big Apple and personally address every
single person who lost a family member in the 2001 World Trade Center attack.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

"He should look them in the eye and tell them that there is no justification
for what happened," LaRosa
[groused](https://x.com/Acyn/status/2086961595486494787). "I would like him to
wipe the grin off his face when he is talking about it, too!"

LaRosa was linking El-Sayed to comments made seven years ago by [influential
leftist streamer](https://zeteo.com/p/hasan-piker-heart-and-
mind?utm_source=publication-search) **Hasan Piker** , who has been campaigning
for El-Sayed. Though Piker [took those remarks
back](https://youtu.be/lKQGvVsRpaE?si=yoirHdCFsIjywWLg&t=40), saying he
"obviously" didn't mean America deserved 9/11, it hasn't mattered to El-Sayed
opponents who have [found their new
bogeyman](https://www.politico.com/news/2026/08/09/trump-elsayed-gop-
boogeyman-01029265). (Notably, Rogers [falsely
claimed](https://www.factcheck.org/2026/08/rogers-makes-false-9-11-claim-
about-el-sayed/) that El-Sayed "believes that America deserved 9/11" shortly
after El-Sayed secured the Dem nomination.)
